behavior: the complete health_snapshots and health_score_history repository boundary moves to Operations Observability while Analytics Reporting retains score computation, trend computation, map construction and presentation orchestration
manager-health-config.ts remains Work Management-owned pure configuration, calculations and data shapes with no Prisma, SQL or Operations dependency
the process-local compatibility latch begins false, returns immediately only after a successful prior ensure, and becomes true only after all four DDL statements complete
compatibility DDL remains four separate sequential nontransactional statements in the inherited order: snapshot table, decline_streak compatibility column, history table, then history index
a failed DDL statement leaves the latch false so a later call retries from the first statement; concurrent first callers remain uncoalesced and can each execute the idempotent four-statement sequence
the four compatibility DDL strings remain byte-identical, unqualified and database-clock based
empty snapshot saves and empty history reads return before compatibility ensure

previous snapshot reads still ensure first, use the same unordered fixed projection, propagate failures and build a caller-owned Map where a later duplicate manager row wins without changing its first insertion position

the primary snapshot upsert remains one atomic PostgreSQL statement with caller order and duplicate manager IDs preserved; duplicate conflicts therefore retain same-statement cardinality failure and atomic rollback
the primary upsert failure remains visible and prevents any history append attempt

history append remains a second nontransactional statement, uses its own statement-stable database NOW(), retains the strict recorded_at greater-than one-hour predicate and remains failure-tolerant with the exact existing log prefix
history rows are not deduplicated or reordered before the append statement
history reads retain the database NOW() window, manager_id and recorded_at ascending order, default seven-day period and Math.min-only upper cap of thirty days
negative and fractional history periods remain accepted on the existing consumer path; a new public caller cannot request a window greater than thirty days
history ensure, query and mapping failures retain the exact existing catch, log prefix and empty-or-partial Map return semantics
stored health_level values retain the compatibility cast rather than acquiring runtime row validation
primary and history writes retain separate autocommit boundaries and may receive different database timestamps
the existing Analytics to Operations public dependency is reused; no Work-to-Operations edge, reverse dependency or cycle is added
no transaction, retry wrapper, promise latch, deduplication, lower period bound, clock substitution or rollback compensation is added
bounded_drift: fixed bound UNNEST statements replace dynamically interpolated VALUES SQL, removing quote injection capacity while preserving input correlation, order, duplicate behavior, atomicity and database clock semantics
generated SQL text, PostgreSQL parameter coercion details, error class/message and recorded query text can differ from the legacy interpolated statements

strict versioned request parsing can reject malformed envelopes, unsupported versions, extra fields, empty manager identifiers, invalid health levels and non-finite numeric values earlier than the legacy raw path

the public history parser rejects periods greater than thirty days instead of silently broadening repository authority; the existing consumer still performs the inherited Math.min cap before calling it
owner-side snake-case to camel-case mapping and public-handler frames add negligible in-process timing and can change stack traces without changing successful values

finite fractional score or streak values remain contract-valid for compatibility even though the actual health computation produces integers; database cast errors or coercion are surfaced by the owner write
out_of_scope: manager-health scoring, thresholds, stability, risk persistence or intervention business-policy changes
schema migration design, removal of compatibility DDL or compatibility tables
the inherited Analytics imports of Work Management pure configuration
contact topology, contact merge, AI governance, Calling configuration and remaining unsafe-fragment slices
raw-write-owner-overrides and frozen CRM-ARCH-003 ownership evidence regeneration
database access, repository execution, scheduler execution, service or runtime activation, deployment and production mutation
